sbx.versionDesc: What every {kind} sandbox in this Studio is built from.

rollouts.newDesc: Existing sandboxes stay on v{v} until updated below.
rollouts.allDesc: Rebuilds every project sandbox tonight at 02:00.
rollouts.chooseDesc: Project owners get an Update button in project settings.

sbx.rolledBack: {name} rolled back to v{v} · sandboxes rebuild on next start
sbx.sourceDesc: Where the Studio gets the {kind} template every project sandbox starts from.

sources.gitDesc: Clone a template repo. Pin a tag, branch or commit.
sources.templateDesc: Maintained by Platon, with update channels.
sources.imageDesc: Pull a prebuilt image from your registry.
sources.archiveDesc: Upload a .zip or .tar.gz of the template.

sbx.tokenHint: Stored in Studio secrets. Read-only repository scope is enough.
sbx.tokenPending: New token is saved with the other changes.
sbx.deployKey: Deploy key · add to the repository
sbx.deployKeyHint: Generated by the Studio. Give it read-only access.

channelNotes.stable: New minor versions about once a month. Shown as an update here; nothing changes until you apply it.
channelNotes.lts: Security and bug fixes only, supported for 18 months. Best for production-heavy Studios.
channelNotes.beta: Early versions for testing. Don’t use for projects with live users.

sbx.pinnedHint: Pinned version. Updates still appear above.
sbx.dropHint: Up to 200 MB. Must include platon.sandbox.json at the root.
sbx.archiveNote: Archives have no update channel. Upload a new archive to change the version; the previous one stays in History for rollback.
sbx.requiredBody2: file at the root. It tells the Studio how to install, run and build the sandbox, and which folders Studio AI may write.
sbx.runDesc: Commands the Studio runs inside each project sandbox.
sbx.resourcesDesc: Limits for one project sandbox. Sleeping sandboxes wake on the next request.
sbx.maxHint: Across all projects on this server
sbx.networkDesc: What sandboxes can reach while installing packages and running.
sbx.registryHint: Mirror used for installs. Empty uses the public npm registry.
sbx.envDesc: Added to every {kind} sandbox. Projects can override plain values; secrets stay hidden from projects and AI.
sbx.secretTitle: Secret · hidden from projects and AI. Click to make plain (needs a new value).
sbx.plainTitle: Plain value · click to make secret
sbx.aiAccessDesc: Folders Studio AI may create and change files in. Everything else is read-only to AI.
sbx.reviewLabel: Changes by Studio AI need a review before they run
sbx.projectsDesc: Sandbox version each project is running.
sbx.historyDesc: Template versions applied in this Studio. Roll back if an update breaks projects.
sbx.dirty: Unsaved changes to the {kind} sandbox. Running sandboxes pick them up on their next restart.
